name: Ascension
audio: a rushing tide, a rising harp and choir swell and a deep whale-like dragon call; no speech
world: The sea temple is alive: water arcs and spheres drift, moonlit surf crashes below, spray hangs in the air, the lighthouse beam sweeps across the waves and ripples run over the stone.

actions.beat: The harbour below draws back and great arcs of tidal water rise into the air, floating spheres of water catching the moonlight.
{{She}} raises the staff and sweeps {{her}} other arm wide as the pearl ignites and a spiral of living water coils up the shaft, {{her}} hair and gown lifting as if underwater.
Aquaria rises out of the sea beyond the terrace and arches over {{her}} as the water spheres settle into an orbiting ring, and {{she}} turns a calm, sovereign look to the camera.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
